column1: # The inflection rules, tried in order per kind; the first whose condition holds
#   order      the order tried within the kind, lowest first
#   condition  a named predicate over the stem and letter.tsv; * always holds
#                ends_sibilant      stem ends in a sibilant ending
#                ends_sibilant_o    ends_sibilant, or a verb_es ending
#                ends_consonant_y   ends in y after a non-vowel (needs a stem)
#                ends_vowel_y       ends in y after a vowel
#                ends_silent_e      ends in a silent e with a letter before it
#                ends_single_e      ends_silent_e, and the letter before is not e
#   strip      how many letters to drop from the end of the stem
#   add        what to write after; ~ stands for the stem's last letter
